test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-5) Official Paper (Held On: 12 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Under which flagship programme did the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship launch a pilot project to revive Kashmir's Namda craft in November 2021?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 3.0**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A pilot initiative was started by the **Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship** to bring **Kashmir's Namda craft back to life.**
 
• **The Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana 3.0** saw the launch of the Namda Craft Pilot Project.
 
• 25 batches are required for implementation. Three training cycles are required for these 25 batches.
 
• Three and a half months will be allocated to each training cycle.
 
• 2,250 persons will gain from the project.
 
• Through Recognition of Prior Learning, the project will improve people's learning (a component of Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana). 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **A sheepskin rug is known as a Namda.**

 
 
• The craft uses a felting technique rather than the standard weaving procedure.
 
• The majority of floor pieces made using Namda craft are for floors.
 
• Additionally, mattresses and bed covers are made from it.
 
• There is a tradition of sitting on the floor in every Kashmiri household, regardless of wealth. In the winter, the floor gets very chilly.
 
• Because of this, Namda craft evolved in Kashmir. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The capacity development scheme** is an ongoing MoSPI (Ministry of Data & Programme Implementation) central sector programme with the general goal of increasing infrastructural, technical, and human resources in order to make reliable and timely official statistics available.
 
• **The Pradhan Mantri Vaya Vandana Yojana** is a pension-insurance programme that offers security to senior folks.
 
• **A Rozgar Mela **is a gathering of businesses and job seekers where applications and interviews are conducted for open positions.
